result.title: Selective Next-Location Prediction with MetaModelSelect: A Lightweight Post-Hoc Confidence Metamodel
result.comment: accepted at IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI) 2026
result.summary: Next-location prediction can support proactive mobile-network decisions, but acting on unreliable predictions can waste resources. We apply MetaModelSelect, a lightweight post-hoc confidence metamodel, to selective cellular next-location prediction. The mobility-specific model combines a learned embedding of the predicted location with the four largest softmax probabilities and Softmax Concentration. It learns whether a frozen recurrent neural network's top-1 prediction is correct, using only its outputs and without retraining the backbone. On path-balanced Changchun cellular mobility trajectories, we evaluate backbones trained with cross-entropy (CE) and self-adaptive training plus entropy minimization (SAT+EM), comparing against eight scalar confidence scores, two location-aware lookup methods, and a raw-logit multilayer perceptron. Relative to maximum softmax probability, MetaModelSelect achieves mean per-run reductions in area under the risk--coverage curve (AURC), excess AURC (E-AURC), and area under the generalized risk--coverage curve (AUGRC) of 2.6%, 4.2%, and 3.0% for CE, and 2.0%, 3.3%, and 1.9% for SAT+EM. It also achieves the lowest reported mean risk at every evaluated partial coverage. The results show that MetaModelSelect improves confidence ranking in this mobility setting while leaving the underlying location predictor unchanged.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文把轻量后验置信度元模型 MetaModelSelect 用于选择性蜂窝下一位置预测：在不重训骨干 RNN 的前提下，用预测位置的嵌入、前四大的 softmax 概率和 Softmax Concentration 判断 top-1 预测是否正确，并在风险—覆盖类指标上与多种标量置信度、查表和 logit MLP 基线比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对冻结骨干的输出做后验置信度学习以决定是否采纳预测」的思路，可能为 LVR 中何时停止推理、是否信任 latent 答案或中间状态的可信度估计提供线索；但任务域（蜂窝移动性预测）相距较远，迁移可行性与替代性可供核查。
